_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Coil base rate (±2 score break only 7% of recent 12h windows) plus analyst confirmation that inflows/ETF/opex are price-dip bias not yet a rung-breaker keeps phase inside 47-54.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst forward is HOLD/Complacency with short-lean tactical bias; narrative has no forward phase call
next_move.confirmed_if: Phase score stays inside 47-54 and BTC fails to reclaim 80k through opex and the 72h post-FOMC window
next_move.invalidated_if: Score leaves 47-54 — daily close above 80k into Disbelief or flush below 47 into Anxiety
